table inet blackhole {
	set banned {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 45.128.232.0/24, 77.239.124.179,
			     109.160.32.0/24, 176.53.159.197,
			     185.220.101.42, 193.32.162.11,
			     198.51.100.20, 203.0.113.10,
			     213.209.159.88 }
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		ip saddr @banned counter packets 10274 bytes 616528 drop
	}
}
table ip filter {
	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
	}
}
table inet f2b-table {
	set addr-set-sshd {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 92.118.39.85, 141.98.11.23 }
	}

	chain f2b-chain {
		type filter hook input priority filter - 1; policy accept;
		ip saddr @addr-set-sshd counter packets 512 bytes 30720 reject
	}
}
